These two images are *reference photos*, not an assertion that the nearby 3D models were reconstructed from georeferenced photography.

Files:
- `library-front-2021.jpg`: 960px reduced preview of **西安交通大学 钱学森图书馆和四大发明广场.jpg**, photographed by **Liuxingy**, **2021-09-06**. Original and author attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E8%A5%BF%E5%AE%89%E4%BA%A4%E9%80%9A%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%A6_%E9%92%B1%E5%AD%A6%E6%A3%AE%E5%9B%BE%E4%B9%A6%E9%A6%86%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%9B%E5%A4%A7%E5%8F%91%E6%98%8E%E5%B9%BF%E5%9C%BA.jpg
- `library-aerial-2025.jpg`: 960px reduced preview of **西交兴庆之俯视钱学森图书馆.jpg**, photographed by **Liuxingy**, **2025-07-25**. Original and author attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E8%A5%BF%E4%BA%A4%E5%85%B4%E5%BA%86%E4%B9%8B%E4%BF%AF%E8%A7%86%E9%92%B1%E5%AD%A6%E6%A3%AE%E5%9B%BE%E4%B9%A6%E9%A6%86.jpg

## North and south gate photos (2011)

These Commons files are historical photographic references, not 2026 live conditions or measurable 3D scans. Both are unmodified scene content as Commons-provided 960px thumbnails.

- `north-gate-2011.jpg` — **XJTU Main Gate.JPG**; photographer **IronBlood**; 2011-04-08; original https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:XJTU_Main_Gate.JPG
- `south-gate-2011.jpg` — **XJTU Gate.jpg**; photographer **Jucember**; 2011-08-19; original https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:XJTU_Gate.jpg

Both use **CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported**, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Retain author credit, original file links, and license links in the interface. These photographs remain separately licensed; using them does not make our approximate 3D meshes true architectural records. The source images have only been resized by the Commons thumbnail service.

The separate file `north-gate-calligraphy-crop.png` **is an adapted derivative** of IronBlood's `XJTU_Main_Gate.JPG` under CC BY-SA 3.0. Changes: cropped original 960px thumbnail to pixels (90,20)-(478,150), remapped luminance for visibility on a white virtual fascia, saved as PNG, then mapped as a facade texture. Credit: IronBlood / Wikimedia Commons, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:XJTU_Main_Gate.JPG; license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. This derivative is separately CC BY-SA 3.0. Do not claim that applying the texture makes the surrounding model measured, surveyed, or currently accurate.
